receives the money. Daniel and Elena want the surviving owner to buy the
deceased owner's business interest at an agreed value or under an agreed
valuation method. The buy-sell agreement creates the purchase framework. Life
insurance can supply money for the death-triggered purchase. The agreement
and the policy are separate documents. A policy alone does not decide the share

The family receives the purchase price for the interest.

The repair company owns and is beneficiary of policies on its owners.

corporate setting.
The business, rather than Elena individually, makes the purchase.

The employer provides the agreed compensation support.
That payment alone does not make the employer the policy owner.
The arrangement can include tax-related bonus planning, which needs its own review.

A buy-sell funds an ownership purchase.
